years.source: RBI, Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy 2023-24 (original source: Labour Bureau)
years.source_table: Table 37: Consumer Price Index - Annual Average, p. 71
years.method_note: CPI-Combined does not exist before January 2011. Value = published CPI-IW General annual average (base 2001=100) of 117 ratio-spliced onto the CPI-Combined base-2012 series at the FY2011-12 overlap: 117 x (93.3 / 195) = 117 x 0.478462. Cross-checked against Economic Survey 2016-17 Statistical Appendix Table 5.3 (identical CPI-IW values). The 2005-06 CPI-IW value of 117 is itself a linked value: the base-2001 CPI-IW series starts January 2006, and RBI/Labour Bureau publish 2005-06 by dividing the base-1982 annual average (542) by the official linking factor 4.63 (HBS Table 37 Note 2).
